instruction: Follow up with Dana about the proposal if she hasn't replied.
final_text:
Dana hadn't replied, so I sent her a follow-up.

- **What I found:** You emailed Dana Okafor (dana@pinecrest.example) the proposal link on Wed 23 Sep. I found no emails from her since then, in that thread or anywhere else.
- **What I sent:** A short reply in the same "Northwind proposal" thread. It includes the proposal link again, asks whether she and her team have had a chance to look at it, and offers to walk them through it at a time that suits them.

I didn't set a reminder to check again. If you want one, I can set it for a few days from now in case she still doesn't answer.
